images.alt: Aerial view of a lone rider on a dirt road through scrubland, with a thought bubble holding cartoon Gravel God's grimacing head: "FML just kill me. Even your dog doesn't like you. You're ugly and that can't be fixed. Quit and never come back. You're as bright as a tunnel."
